name: Fruit Orchard
tagline: Sunny classic fruits. Frequent small wins.
featureText: Every new 🌟 sticks in place and all other cells respin, up to 3 times. Each respin pays.

freeSpins.name: Sticky Wild Free Spins
freeSpins.text: Every 🌟 that lands stays put until the free spins end.

bonus.name: Harvest Pick
bonus.text: Pick baskets to collect prizes until you find a 🐛 worm.

jackpot.name: Golden Apples
jackpot.text: Golden apples can land on any spin: 3 🍎 win the MINOR, 4 the MAJOR, 5 the GRAND. The bigger your bet, the better your chance.

collector.name: Apple Tree
collector.text: Every 🍃 that lands grows the Apple Tree, shared by all players. The spin that fills the tree starts the Harvest Festival.

reward.name: Harvest Festival
reward.text: 10 sticky-wild free spins where every win pays ×2.
